scope: 12 major retail Deposit Money Banks operating in Nigeria — all 7 commercial banks holding CBN International Authorization plus 5 nationwide retail commercial banks holding CBN National Authorization — manually verified with corporate headquarters, CBN commercial banking licence tier, 3-digit NIP/CBN bank code, example 9-digit head-office cheque-clearing sort code, and public retail USSD shortcuts. Regional commercial banks, merchant banks, non-interest banks, and microfinance banks are outside this Phase 1 retail directory.
notes: Sort codes are the 3-digit NIP/CBN bank codes used for NUBAN transfers (commonly called sort codes). 9-digit head-office sort codes are legacy cheque-clearing codes where the first 3 digits match the NIP code. USSD codes are dialled on the phone linked to the bank account; they can change — verify critical actions in the official bank app or branch before transacting. Independent reference — do NOT claim CBN endorsement. Every factual field cites its source in the per-bank sources list.
